candidate_attempt_limit: No success quota. Retain actual derivation/repair attempts; unresolved target clauses must remain open.
stage_cost: active chat cost unmeasured; native wall time recorded from executions
stage_policy: P0 semantic mining and reviewed missions precede P1; P2 native predicates; P3 only actual repair; P4 actual challenges including task-specific semantic near misses; P5 result or exact obstruction.
independent_review: A node whose DAG status depends on its result needs a second reviewer who is not its author; finalize refuses without one.
batch_stop: After the selected prompt executions and substantive review, commit; push and open a PR only on request.
